lines.t: Thanks for watching!
The earth stands still, the king advances by his will
Many crowns upon his head, a name unknown, a path of dread
Faithful, true, he rides ahead
The ground shakes hard beneath his feet, justice rolls with thunder's beat
Nations cut through with the sword
All creation will know the Lord
He rides to war in righteous flame
The Word of God, eternal name
King of kings, Lord of lords
The nations fall before his sword
The armies follow, clothed in white
Pure and ready for the fight
He speaks once, his truth cuts deep
Kings grow silent, strongholds weep
From his mouth the sword goes forth
Judgment burns from south to north
No throne stands, no crown remains
When he steps onto the plain
The winepress awaits the hour near
Time is at hand, not ruled by fear
He does not fail, he does not stall
The true king now calls it all
He rides to war in righteous flame
The Word of God, eternal name
King of kings, Lord of lords
The nations fall before His sword
Trumpets cry, lightning collide Heaven's host at his side
Steel and fire, truth and might He rules the age
He rides to war, no rival stands
The world is judged by nail-pierced hands
King of kings, lord of lords
All bow down before the Lord
On his road, on his life
And across the burning night
King of kings
Lord of lords
C.A.R.T.
